items.text: Drake Maye (ankle) will undergo more tests, but the Patriots "expect that he will be out a while." Via @SNFonNBC
items.why: Ankle injury from earlier today; Patriots expect extended absence per NBC report.
items.implication: Increases value of NE backup RB situation; Corey Kiner (waiver target) could see elevated role if Stevenson/Henderson remain limited.
items.opportunity: Monitor Kiner usage and Stevenson/Henderson status for potential waiver claim if Maye absence affects game script or RB volume.
corroboration: Mike Florio on SNF: Patriots expect Maye to be “out for a while.”

items.text: A prolonged offensive funk and an uncertain QB situation. Such is the current state of the Jets. Garrett Wilson: “Bad ball. Bad football.” Indeed. #Jets
items.why: Geno Smith suffered ankle injury in Jets loss to Bills.
items.implication: JD's starting QB may be limited or out next week; monitor for backup situation or IR.
items.opportunity: If Geno misses time, consider waiver QB options or reliance on Sam Darnold (also banged up).
corroboration: Establish The Run listed Geno Smith (ankle) among injuries to watch.
